name: clonamic-herness-plugin
description: Portable judgment, write approval, completion verification, and concise reporting for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Approve writes once, verify completion, report clearly.
interface.longDescription: Adds a portable decision layer for Codex and other coding agents: reads stay direct, writes receive a proportional approval gate, approved loops continue autonomously, and completion is verified before reporting.
defaultPrompt: Use Clonamic to inspect this project without changing files.
Use Clonamic to propose and apply this write safely.
Use Clonamic to verify whether this task is truly complete.
